**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 8 already satisfies the preferred RENEWAL position in every respect:

- **Renewal term:** successive twelve-month periods (§ 8.2) — no multi-year auto-renewal.
- **Opt-out:** Customer only needs to give thirty days' written notice of non-renewal (§ 8.2) — meets the ≤ 30-day preferred window.
- **Reminder:** Vendor must remind Customer at least sixty days before renewal, and a missed reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline to thirty days after receipt (§ 8.2) — better than the playbook baseline.
- **Price uplift:** capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods (§ 8.3) — matches the preferred cap.

Cross-check of Section 7 found no separate renewal escalator; § 7.1 fixes Fees during the initial term. The three-year figure in § 8.1 is the master agreement term rather than a renewal term, so the walk-away trigger for automatic multi-year renewals is not engaged.

*(Unrelated note outside this rule's scope: § 7.7 imposes liquidated damages of fifteen percent of annual Fees per week on Customer for late payment — that should be picked up under the payment/late-fee rule.)*
